sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: An Exposed creature suffers −1 to all Defenses. Exposed lasts until the end of that creature's next Turn unless the effect specifies another duration. Reapplication refreshes or extends duration without shortening the time remaining; the penalty does not stack.

sections.label: LIMIT
sections.html: Exposed does not automatically remove Cover, reveal a Hidden creature, or cancel another defensive effect.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
